headline: Study finds microplastics react with water, raising new health questions
summary: A new study reports that microplastics are not chemically inert in water, reacting with it to produce potentially damaging chemicals on their own. The discovery raises unresolved questions about the health effects on people, since microplastics interact with one of the most common molecules in the environment and in human bodies.

claims.statement: A new study finds that microplastics are not inert in water and can react to produce new, potentially damaging chemicals.

sources.quote: aren’t inert and make damaging chemicals on their own

claims.statement: The health effects on people from this reaction remain uncertain.
